description:
Because:
- Tailwind 3 is outdated, and all packages must move to v4 together.

This commit:
- Updates tailwindcss to 4.3.3 with @tailwindcss/postcss and @tailwindcss/cli.
- Removes plugins and PostCSS deps that v4 makes redundant.
- Loads the JS configs with @config and renames v3 utilities.
- Converts @apply targets to @utility, @screen to @variant, flattens &-suffix nesting.
- Inlines SVGs in the configs because the v4 CLI runs no PostCSS.

Closes FXA-11093
